why: Welcome's step names are the owner's (English until Tier 2) and the rail wraps them by design: a step's whole name, never cut.
A provider tile is a card: its description is a paragraph that wraps by design.
A select shows its whole choice, wrapping a long one rather than cutting it with an ellipsis (controls.css).
A small button wraps its words rather than running out of its row; only the stretched qps words make it two lines, Bulgarian keeps one.
One stretched qps word ('подразбиране······') is longer than any Bulgarian word; in Bulgarian the name fits its column.
The heartbeat's cadence line overruns its column by 2px under qps only.
A connection's name and host are one unbreakable word each beside the actions at tablet width under qps; Bulgarian fits.
